content.title: Where to watch Michigan vs. St. Louis March Madness matchup for free today
content.text: Updated: Mar. 21, 2026, 10:00 a.m.Published: Mar. 21, 2026, 10:00 a.m.Michigan Wolverines forward Yaxel Lendeborg (23) as Michigan faces Howard in the first round of the NCAA basketball tournament in Buffalo, New York on Thursday, March 19 2026.Jacob Hamilton | MLive.comIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe No. 1 Michigan Wolverines will continue their March Madness journey today with a second-round matchup against the No. 9 St. Louis Billikens. Fans can catch the action from Buffalo on CBS at 12:10 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and Paramount+. CBS March Madness Streaming OptionsTable not scrollableFubo: Fubo plans start at $73.99 per month and include access to CBS and other local channels such as ABC and Fox but do not include TNT, TruTV or TBS. New subscribers can start with a free trial and take $25 off the first month of their subscription. DirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Pro plan comes with CBS for $94.99 per month. New subscribers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off their first month. This plan also comes with TNT, TruTV and TBS. Paramount+: Premium plans regularly start at $13.99 per month and include a live feed of the CBS broadcast. However, Paramount+ is currently offering a deal where new and returning customers can get any plan for just $2.99 a month for their first two months.
